newsitem.title: USA: Micronics holding talks with Hayes Micro.
newsitem.headline: Micronics holding talks with Hayes Micro.

text.p: Micronics Computers Inc said Friday it is holding discussions with Hayes Microcomputer Products Inc, a privately held company, concerning a potential stock-for-stock merger.
Micronics said it is aware of unusual trading volume in its stock and a recent rise in the trading price of its stock and has made the above statement in response to the activity.
The company noted that it had previously announced that it had hired a financial advisor to identify acquisition and strategic partner relationships.

The parties have not entered into any letter of intent or binding agreement and the outcome of any discussions with Hayes is uncertain at this time, since several of the principal terms remain unresolved, Micronics said.
